“大壮，你带着大黄不要发出动静！”

李青山提醒了一声后，便悄无声息的朝着前方狍子靠近了过去，眼神中流露出一抹锐利和小心，生怕惊动了狍子。

野狍子的听觉十分灵敏，稍微一些风吹草动便能够发现。

只不过这家伙在逃跑的时候，经常会‘站桩’式的停下来，观察四周，这也就有了傻狍子的称呼，别的野兽都是撒腿就跑，怎么可能会突然停下观察四周？

这不是纯纯找死的吗？

自己手中这把弓，大概是六十磅，狍子属于中型野物，若是想要将其射杀，最好是靠近三十米之内，将猎弓的威力发挥到最强。

调整呼吸，没一脚小心的落在地上。

正在啃食青草的傻狍子，没有丝毫察觉，李青山已经靠近了过来。

五十米，四十八米，四十三米……！

三十七米……！

“噌！！”

李青山尚且还未靠近到三十米时，这只野狍子似乎发现了什么，突然抬起头来，目光朝着李青山的方向望了过来，眼神中闪过一抹茫然和警惕。

坏了，被发现了。

李青山心中一紧，这边的灌木丛很高，李青山发出的声音也不大，还以为能够躲过去，悄然靠近。

却不曾想，小看这野物了。

趴在后面的大壮见状，也是心中一紧，暗叫一声不好。

到手的狍子，要跑了。

这次若是带的猎枪出来，这野狍子肯定跑不了，真是可惜了。

这一只野狍子。

可是足足有六十斤重啊！！

“欻……！”

就在李青山准备冲出去，强行射杀野狍子的时候，前面的灌木丛中，一只野兔跑了出去。

野狍子见只是一只野兔，便再次低下头去啃食鲜嫩的青草。

李青山心中悬着的那块石头，终于落了下去，再次悄无声息的靠近。

三十米，到了！！

拉弓，满月！

李青山发现，刚刚差点惊扰到野狍子的那只野兔子，并未走远，而是在野狍子不远的地方也啃食起了新鲜的嫩草。

瞄准颈部！！

“欻！”

一道破空声响起，李青山手中的长箭瞬间飞蛇而出，在空中划过一条弧线，正在吃草的野狍子尚未反应过来，长箭便已经洞穿了野狍子的颈部。

“扑腾……！”

野狍子脚下一个趔趄，差点倒在地上，大量的鲜血潺潺流淌，迅速带着长箭朝着远处狂奔。

可惜，没跑两步，便直接跌倒在地上抽搐起来。

李青山射出第一根箭后，并未停留，第二根长箭已经搭在长弓之上，朝着逃走的野兔子射了过去。

又是一道沉闷的声音响起。

第二只野兔子，同样被李青山钉死在地上，身体剧烈抽搐着，身后的大黄也在这个时候冲了出去。

“走！”

李青山轻呵一声，带着身后的大壮便朝着前面跑了过去。

“山哥，你也太厉害了，这么一把弓，连狍子都能拿下？”大壮望着地上的狍子，脸上满是兴奋道：“不过山哥，这狍子怎么处理啊？”

“看好了！”

李青山拎着柴刀便开始上手，很快便将眼前的狍子临时处理个干净，主要是给狍子放血，以防影响肉质，等回到趟子房后，统一将皮给剥下来，死的太久会影响皮毛。

一箭直接命中的脖颈！！

这种剥下来的袍子皮是最为上乘的，因为一般猎人猎杀狍子都是直接猎枪击杀，有些会直接打在身上，会将皮草打出来一个洞一个洞的，还有烧焦的迹象，实在是不讨喜。

卖相差的狍子皮，可能才不过四块多钱一张！！

但是卖相好一些的袍子皮，可以达到八块钱左右，李青山这一张袍子皮倒是难得，十五块钱应当是没问题！！

不过，李青山就是有些担心，这天气太热。

会不会导致狍子肉质变质！！

还得在趟子房旁边，挖个地窖，下次来的时候，带些盐巴出来，这样可以让肉存放的久一些。

“山哥，这狍子太重了，咱们先扛回去吧？”大壮看着地上的狍子和野兔，开口道。

“也行！”

李青山点了点头，大壮当即扛起六十斤的狍子，二人先回了一趟趟子房，将狍子和野兔放好，这才继续出发。

这一次，李青山的运气就没这么好了。

顺着小溪走了一趟，也没发现野物，就在李青山准备离开小溪流，去钻旁边老林子的时候，胸口的玉葫芦吊坠突然微微发热起来。

又有猎物？

感受到玉葫芦的提醒，李青山目光连忙朝着四周环顾。

“山哥，看啥呢？”大壮见李青山立刻警觉起来，眼神中闪过一抹诧异道。

“沙沙沙……！”

果然。

树叶相互碰撞摩擦的声音由小到大，开始朝着李青山这边传了过来，李青山和大壮立刻发现了声音来源处，目光所示，两只野狍子正朝着李青山和大壮这边跑来。

其中一只野狍子的身上，还残存着一些血迹。

不知道如何受伤的。

“大壮，准备好了，我把狍子放近了就射杀，你干掉另外一个！！”

李青山长呼一口气，开口道。

一次射出两根箭，不是不可以，但是威力锐减，猎杀野兔还可以，想要猎杀狍子就有些困难了。

这两只狍子刚巧不巧，就是朝着自己和大壮跑过来的。

大壮手中的长枪，只要判断得当，有机会戳中其中一只慌不择路的狍子，就算是刺不中，自己也可以帮忙容错。

“好！”

大壮郑重点了点头，潜伏在一旁后，长呼一口气，压制住内心的激动和亢奋，双手握住长枪的手心都开始冒汗了。

"Dazhuang, don't make any noise while you are carrying Dahuang!"

After Li Qingshan reminded him, he quietly approached the roe deer in front of him, his eyes showing sharpness and caution, for fear of alarming the roe deer.

The hearing of wild roe deer is very sensitive, and it can detect the slightest disturbance.

It's just that when this guy is running away, he will often stop and look around, which is why he is called the Silly Roe Deer. Other beasts just run away, so how could he suddenly stop and look around?

Isn't this just looking for death?

The bow in his hand weighs about sixty pounds. Roe deer is a medium-sized wild animal. If you want to shoot it, it is best to get within thirty meters to maximize the power of the hunting bow.

He adjusted his breathing and landed on the ground without any care.

The silly roe deer, which was eating green grass, did not notice that Li Qingshan was approaching.

Fifty meters, forty-eight meters, forty-three meters...!

Thirty-seven meters...!

"Oops!!"

Before Li Qingshan got closer than thirty meters, the wild roe deer seemed to have discovered something. It suddenly raised its head and looked in the direction of Li Qingshan, with a look of confusion and vigilance in its eyes.

Broken, discovered.

Li Qingshan's heart tightened. The bushes here were very tall, and Li Qingshan didn't make much noise. He thought he could hide away and approach quietly.

But I never thought that I would underestimate this wild creature.

When Da Zhuang, who was lying behind, saw this, his heart tightened and he secretly screamed something bad.

The roe deer that I got is about to run away.

If the shotgun he brought out this time, the wild roe deer would definitely not be able to escape. It would be a pity.

This is a wild roe deer.

But it weighs a full sixty kilograms!!

"Tian...!"

Just when Li Qingshan was about to rush out and shoot the wild roe deer, a hare ran out from the bushes in front of him.

Seeing that it was just a hare, the wild roe deer lowered its head again to nibble on the fresh green grass.

The stone hanging in Li Qingshan's heart finally fell and approached quietly again.

Thirty meters, here it is!!

Draw your bow, full moon!

Li Qingshan discovered that the wild rabbit that almost disturbed the wild roe deer had not gone far, but was nibbling on fresh grass not far from the wild roe deer.

Aim for the neck!!

"Tian!"

A sound broke through the air, and the long arrow in Li Qingshan's hand flew out instantly, drawing an arc in the air. Before the grazing wild roe deer could react, the long arrow had already pierced the neck of the wild roe deer.

"Thump...!"

The wild roe deer staggered and almost fell to the ground. A large amount of blood gurgled and it quickly ran towards the distance with a long arrow.

Unfortunately, he didn't even take two steps before he fell to the ground and started twitching.

After Li Qingshan shot the first arrow, he did not stop. The second long arrow was already placed on the long bow and shot towards the escaping hare.

Another dull voice sounded.

The second wild rabbit was also nailed to the ground by Li Qingshan, its body twitching violently, and Rhubarb behind him also rushed out at this time.

"Let's go!"

Li Qingshan let out a light chuckle and ran forward with Da Zhuang behind him.

"Brother Shan, you are so powerful. With such a bow, you can even take down a roe deer?" Da Zhuang looked at the roe deer on the ground and said with excitement on his face: "But brother Shan, what should I do with this roe deer?"

"Watch it!"

Li Qingshan picked up the hatchet and started to get started. He quickly cleaned up the roe deer in front of him temporarily. He mainly bled the roe deer to prevent the quality of the meat from being affected. After returning to the house, he peeled off the skin. If it was dead for too long, it would affect the fur.

An arrow hit the neck directly!!

This kind of peeled robe skin is the best, because most hunters kill roe deer directly with hunting rifles. Some of them will be shot directly on the body, leaving holes in the fur and signs of burning, which is really unpleasant.

Roe deer skins of different sizes may be sold for just over four yuan a piece!!

However, a better-looking robe leather can cost about eight yuan. Li Qingshan's robe leather is quite rare. Fifteen yuan should be no problem!!

However, Li Qingshan was a little worried because the weather was too hot.

Will it cause the meat of the roe deer to deteriorate?!

You have to dig a cellar next to the house and bring some salt with you when you come next time so that the meat can be stored longer.

"Brother Shan, this roe deer is too heavy, let's carry it back first?" Da Zhuang said, looking at the roe deer and hare on the ground.

"Alright!"

Li Qingshan nodded, and Da Zhuang immediately picked up the sixty kilogram roe deer. The two of them went back to the house first, put the roe deer and hare away, and then continued to set off.

This time, Li Qingshan's luck was not so good.

After walking along the stream, he found no wild animals. Just when Li Qingshan was about to leave the stream and go into the old forest next to it, the jade gourd pendant on his chest suddenly became slightly warm.

Another prey?

Feeling the reminder from Jade Gourd, Li Qingshan quickly looked around.

"Brother Shan, what are you looking at?" Da Zhuang immediately became alert when he saw Li Qingshan, with a flash of surprise in his eyes.

"Shashasha...!"

Sure enough.

The sound of leaves colliding with each other grew from small to loud, and began to come towards Li Qingshan. Li Qingshan and Dazhuang immediately discovered the source of the sound, and their eyes showed that two wild roe deer were running towards Li Qingshan and Dazhuang.

One of the wild roe deer still had some blood stains on its body.

Don't know how it got hurt.

"Da Zhuang, get ready. I'll shoot the roe deer as soon as I get close. You kill the other one!!"

Li Qingshan took a long breath and said.

It's not impossible to shoot two arrows at once, but the power is greatly reduced. It's okay to hunt hares, but it's a little difficult to hunt roe deer.

By chance, these two roe deer ran towards him and Da Zhuang.

As long as the spear in Da Zhuang's hand is judged correctly, there is a chance to poke one of the panicked roe deer. Even if the spear misses, he can help to make mistakes.

"Okay!"

Da Zhuang nodded solemnly, lurked aside, took a long breath, suppressed the excitement and excitement in his heart, and the palms of his hands holding the spear began to sweat.
